detail.longDescription:
Freely upload and transfer files to the cloud, and share them with others with one click. Back up and sync all documents and media, accessible anytime across multiple devices. High-speed distribution for large files enables hassle-free transfers for work and daily use.
- Automatically back up gallery media to the cloud in the background, share photos and videos effortlessly
- Access all files offline; preview over 175 formats directly without extra software
- Convenient sharing and delivery of extra-large files
- Capture receipts, IDs and photos via mobile phone for instant viewing and forwarding

  -Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
  -Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
  -Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
